# Dratun Studio

Dratun Studio is a specialized provider of advanced insulated packaging solutions designed for the pharmaceutical cold-chain sector. Our flagship product, FrostGuard, ensures reliable maintenance of subzero environments during the shipment of temperature-sensitive pharmaceuticals such as vaccines and biologics. By combining proprietary multi-layer insulation materials with integrated phase-change technology, FrostGuard reduces temperature excursions significantly, preserving drug efficacy throughout transit.

Our primary customers are pharmaceutical manufacturers, contract logistics providers, and healthcare distributors engaged in cold-chain logistics. In recent pilot trials with two mid-size vaccine manufacturers, FrostGuard packaging reduced temperature excursions by 40%, leading to fewer product rejections and improved supply chain reliability.

Founded in 2022 and based in Northbridge, Dratun Studio completed a $3.5 million seed round in Q4 2023 led by Verdant Ventures and Arctic Horizon Capital. With a core team of 12 specialists in materials science, thermal engineering, and cold-chain operations, we are expanding manufacturing partnerships to scale production in 2024.

Key competitors include CryoPack Solutions and PolarVault Systems, who offer standard insulated boxes lacking FrostGuard’s integrated phase-change layers. Major risks involve raw material price volatility and evolving cold-chain regulatory standards, which we monitor closely to adapt product design and ensure compliance.
